question: Is gOHM (or OHM) listed as borrowable collateral on any third-party lending market, and if so does its oracle read a manipulable spot/AMM price?
method: Morpho Blue GraphQL (all chains, collateral+loan), Aave v3 getReservesList (Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon), DefiLlama yields (all chains, all protocols), Inverse FiRM market read on-chain, web search.

defillama_yields_all_chains.note: the only gOHM-symbol pools are two uniswap-v3 DEX pools (GOHM-WETH $23.9k, GOHM-USDC $14.2k); no Lending-category pool contains OHM or gOHM on any of the 15 tracked chains

euler_v2.note: DefiLlama tracks Euler v2 vaults on 16 chains; none contain OHM/gOHM

inverse_firm_gohm.oracle_type: Chainlink-style 'Pessimistic Oracle' (daily-low dampened); feed = 'gOhmV2 / USD' 0xe893297a9d4310976424fD0B25f53aC2B6464fe3, latest answer 5,384.8656e18 (2026-10-21)
inverse_firm_gohm.status: PHASED OUT. New borrows paused; zero outstanding debt; on-fork borrow() reverts. Even if live, the oracle is a Chainlink feed, NOT an AMM spot price, so DEX manipulation would not move it (and the 2-day daily-low dampening makes logging artificial lows useless for a borrower).
inverse_firm_gohm.governance_note: the gOHM market is being phased out per Inverse governance

olympus_own.cooler_v1_clearinghouse: legacy, same protocol family (fixed LTB ~2,892.92 DAI/gOHM), not third-party
olympus_own.flex_loans: legacy whitelisted, gOHM collateral borrowing OHM at 100% LTV; not permissionless

conclusion: There is NO live third-party lending market that accepts gOHM or OHM as collateral, and the only one that ever did (Inverse FiRM gOHM) is paused with zero debt AND uses a Chainlink oracle. The cross-protocol route (borrow cheap gOHM from a spot-oracle lending market) is not available. The cross-protocol verdict is CLOSED.
